emails.subject: Riverside audit fieldwork timing
emails.body:
Hi Mei,

Thanks again for helping with the fieldwork items. We are closing the binder at 4:30 p.m. today, so whenever you can, please send back the transaction dates for the full fieldwork window — January 1 through May 31, 2026 — covering all of your activity for the period.

Best,
Nadia
